# Redaction rules — applied to EVERY capture, episode and curated item
# before it is admitted to the vault (principles.md #10).
#
# One rule per line:
#   Contoso                      literal, case-insensitive → [customer]
#   literal:Fabrikam             same, explicit
#   regex:acme-[a-z0-9]+        regex → [redacted]
#   rule => [token]              custom replacement token
#
# Built-in secret/tenant/internal-URL patterns always run and cannot be
# disabled here. Add your customer names and internal hostnames below.

# Example synthetic entries (safe to replace):
literal:Contoso
literal:Fabrikam => [customer]
regex:https?://[a-z0-9.-]+\.corp\.example\.com/[^\s]* => [internal-url]
